title: The young Akbar becomes Mughal emperor
summary: Thirteen-year-old Akbar was enthroned on a brick platform in a garden at Kalanaur after the sudden death of his father Humayun.
reason: Humayun had died after a fall in his library, and the regent Bairam Khan moved quickly to secure the succession.
significance: Akbar became the greatest Mughal ruler, expanding the empire and promoting religious tolerance.
